_about: Headline numbers for the promo, copied from RESULTS.md / README.md / THEORY.md / best-config.json. Speed values are [value, ledger label, ledger case] (optionally a 4th element naming the field) and are checked against runs/ledger.jsonl (decode_tps, or prefill_tps for pp-* cases; needle-* cases read ttft_s); needles [ctx, label, case] read 'found' (and prompt_n); codeeval against runs/codeeval-<label>.json; the refusal classifier against runs/refusal-<label>.json; greedy identity against runs/greedy/ (texts compared exactly); long answers against runs/longans/; KLD against runs/kld/summary.txt; the default's card VRAM against best-config.json; statements in 'text' are matched word for word in RESULTS.md (keys starting readme_ in README.md, theory_ in THEORY.md). promo/tools/prep.py refuses to mark the set measured if any differ. Derived numbers (speed-ups, the head's share of bytes, percent of ceiling, prefill cost) are computed in prep and compared with the rounded figures RESULTS.md / README.md state.

model.name: Qwen3.5-9B Heretic
model._source: RESULTS.md: 'Qwen3.5-9B hybrid layout: 32 layers, 3 Gated DeltaNet : 1 full attention'; '(8.76 GB, sha256 b54d045c…): Q6_K blocks, imatrix ("NEO" dataset), and a **BF16 output head** (2.03 GB'

bytes._what: THEORY.md: bytes read per emitted token (GB). Each value is also a theory_ text check below

ceilings._what: RESULTS.md / THEORY.md ceilings at the measured acceptance (bytes only)

stock._what: b08: llama-server -m <file> --jinja; --fit picked 4 slots sharing 69,376 tokens of f16 K/V

default._what: b13: serve.sh default, the published file, MTP n=2, 64k f16 K/V, one slot

fast._what: b07: QH_PROFILE=fast, local copy with output.weight BF16 -> Q8_0, MTP n=2, 128k q8_0 K/V

head_ab._what: b04: plain Q8_0 head against the two plain controls either side; MTP n=2 with the Q8_0 head against MTP n=2 on the published file

kld._what: runs/kld/summary.txt, 'Mean KLD' of each change against the published file at its own settings

longans._what: tools/longans.py, six prompts, thinking on, 10k cap, one sample each; plus the 24k-cap rerun of the probability problem (b10)

greedy._what: temperature 0; MTP n=2 vs no speculation, texts compared exactly

results_md._what: figures RESULTS.md / README.md state as rounded; prep checks its own derivations against these

text._what: statements the copy and plates make that are not in a run file as such; each must appear word for word in RESULTS.md (readme_ keys in README.md, theory_ keys in THEORY.md)
text.verdict: The published file as downloaded, all in VRAM, its own MTP head (n=2), f16 K/V, 64k window, one slot.
text.b12242: The same Qwen3.5 family's MTP head looped on long answers with llama.cpp b12242
text.longans: six long answers (to 10k tokens, thinking on) behaved the same with and without MTP, and a 24k-token answer stayed coherent.
text.coherent_24k: used all 24,000 tokens in a coherent, non-repeating case enumeration
text.head: The BF16 head is 26% of the bytes read per token and MTP's draft step reads it again.
text.requant: (48 s on the CPU, every other tensor byte-identical)
text.fast_profile: It is a profile, not the default, because it changes the published file.
text.prefill: MTP costs ~6% of prompt speed (1,681 vs 1,787 tok/s at 8k).
text.no_262k: The full 262k window does not fit with the BF16 head.
text.refusal: **answered 20/20, refused 0**; each answer read and each does what was asked.
text.no_base: No base comparison: no base Qwen3.5-9B file on disk.
text.no_quant_kld: Quantization error against a BF16 or Q8_0 reference (none on disk; nothing downloaded).
text.card_gb: 11.4 GB on the card including the desktop.
text.readme_acceptance: MTP n=2 accepts 85% of drafts on code (79% with thinking on)
text.readme_plain_ceiling: Plain decode tops out at 39.4 tok/s, 90% of the 43.8 tok/s ceiling
text.readme_window: 12 GB holds 64k (f16 K/V) with MTP, 128k with MTP and the Q8_0 head, and 192k without MTP.
text.theory_q8: A Q8_0 head (1.08 GB) would lift the d0 ceiling
text.theory_q8_total: would lift the d0 ceiling to 342 / 6.86 =
text.theory_draft: so one draft token costs ~2.23 GB, 29% of a full step.
